concept: Swiss Arcade Telemetry - A unique fusion of high-end car dashboard clarity, retro arcade tactile buttons, and Swiss transport map precision to overcome the 'boring' app problem.

fonts.heading: Outfit (Geometric, bold, technical - evokes modern car displays)
fonts.body: Plus Jakarta Sans (Highly legible, clean, modern structure)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (For test timers, stats, and data points)

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1.5px or 2px solid #090A0B for interactive cards to create a tactile neo-brutalist feel. Avoid soft, muddy drop shadows.

layouts.padding: Generous spacing philosophy. Cards must have a minimum of 20px internal padding. Screen horizontal padding should be 20px or 24px so content breathes.

PrimaryButton.container: backgroundColor: primary, borderRadius: 9999, paddingVertical: 18, paddingHorizontal: 24, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 1, shadowRadius: 0, shadowColor: '#090A0B', borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#090A0B'

CategoryCard.container: backgroundColor: surface, borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, borderWidth: 2, borderColor: borderHard, marginBottom: 16, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between'

OptionCard.default: backgroundColor: surface, borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: border, borderRadius: 12, padding: 16, marginBottom: 12

AIExplanationBox.container: backgroundColor: '#EEF2FF', borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: premium, borderRadius: 16, padding: 20, marginTop: 16, borderLeftWidth: 6

Header.container: backgroundColor: background, paddingHorizontal: 24, paddingVertical: 16, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: border

iconography: Use bold, consistent vector icons (e.g., Lucide React Native or Phosphor). Ensure stroke widths match the typography weight (usually 2px stroke). Do not mix filled and outlined icons arbitrarily.

motion.buttons: Active opacity 0.8, scale down slightly (0.97) on press to mimic physical tactile feedback.
motion.pageTransition: Use standard slide animations, but consider a fast 150ms-200ms fade for rapid quiz questions to keep momentum.
motion.progressBars: Animate width changes using Reanimated or LayoutAnimation for smooth transitions when users answer questions.

image_urls.description: Empty scenic road landscape, representing the freedom of passing the theory test.
Close-up of a modern steering wheel, evoking tactile, technical driving precision.

accessibility.contrast: All text combinations exceed 4.5:1 WCAG AA. Primary Orange (#FF4500) against stark white cards is verified for visibility.
accessibility.touchTargets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements (buttons, back arrows, toggles).
accessibility.testIDs: CRITICAL: Append testID (for React Native) mapping to data-testid prop to all touchables, e.g., testID='start-practice-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Translate this JSON strictly into React Native StyleSheet objects. Do not use Tailwind CSS web classes as this is an Expo/React Native app.

Implement 'Neo-Brutalism Light' for main action buttons and active cards: use solid borders (borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#090A0B') and sharp, zero-radius drop shadows (e.g. { shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 }, shadowOpacity: 1, shadowRadius: 0 }) to create a highly tactile, gamified feel.
Use layout dimensions dynamically but keep massive padding on container elements (minimum 20px internally).
Make the gamified learning loop clear by highlighting correct (emerald) and incorrect (neon rose) states boldly. The user should instantly know their result.
For the AI explanation, use a distinct UI treatment (indigo borders, subtle purple/indigo background) to differentiate it from standard DVSA content and highlight the premium value.
Timer on the mock test should use the monospaced font and be fixed/sticky at the top.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid standard React Native 'boring' generic defaults. Go for high contrast and strong borders to create personality.
All interactive elements MUST include a `testID` (which maps to `data-testid` on React Native Web) attribute to facilitate automated testing.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for sticky elements/headers. Always use solid backgrounds (like #F4F5F7) so text underneath doesn't collide.
Do not use emoji characters for UI icons; rely on proper vector icon libraries.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
